description: Header file defining the slot_symbol_point class, which combines slot_point and symbol index concepts for timing in a radio system.

classes.name: slot_symbol_point
classes.description: Represents a combined concept of a slot point and symbol index within a slot, with methods for manipulation and comparison.

methods.name: get_slot
methods.description: Returns the slot_point associated with this slot_symbol_point.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the slot_symbol_point is valid based on symbols and numerology.

methods.name: get_symbol_index
methods.description: Returns the symbol index within the slot.

methods.name: get_nof_symbols
methods.description: Returns the number of symbols per slot.

methods.name: to_uint
methods.description: Converts the slot_symbol_point to a raw counter value.
